name: QE

categories.label: Company tile VP
categories.hint: Sum of VP on Company tiles you won

categories.label: Zero bids (max 1 per round)
categories.hint: 2 VP per zero bid, at most 1 per round

categories.label: Nationalization bonus
categories.hint: VP for tiles matching your nation; varies by player count (read from rule table)

categories.label: Monopolization bonus
categories.hint: VP for multiple companies of the same industry; read from rule table

categories.label: Diversification bonus
categories.hint: VP for sets of different industries; read from rule table

categories.label: Total spent (secret)
categories.hint: Reveal tracked spending; highest spender is eliminated

categories.label: Lowest spender bonus
categories.hint: Tick for the player with the lowest total spent (6 VP in 3-4p, 7 VP in 5p)

categories.label: Eliminated (highest spender)
categories.hint: Tick for the highest spender (all tied are eliminated); cannot win

tiebreakers.description: Tied players: least total spent wins

winCondition: Game ends when all Company tiles are awarded. Highest VP wins among players who are not eliminated (highest total spender is eliminated).

endCondition.description: All Company tiles awarded (3-4 rounds, each player auctioneer once per round)

notes: family: auction-money. Exact bonus VP values come from the rulebook tables (vary by player count) and are entered as numbers; not verified against the official rulebook PDF. Auction ties re-bid; 3-player final turn ties give no company.
